test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘RADICAL’ is written as ‘BBDEJMS’ and ‘SUSPECT’ is written as ‘DFQTTUV’. How will ‘VIRTUAL’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘RADICAL’ is written as ‘BBDEJMS’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1be63ab15c73e3ee6fee91864d18152a4c93fa3796173550df5adc99379d8c58.png] 

‘SUSPECT’ is written as ‘DFQTTUV’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d70d6e8ae0a12f10c2cd7fb1ab2066a95814d452c2adfbc57e4b61471aa854a0.png] 

Similarly, 'VIRTUAL’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21fd7923154f535d46257983b5d1f94e119a92275f0ff61699fd0a128b764913.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**BJMSUVW **".
